September is when our warehouse customers start rebuilding their training routines, and I want to give them something practical to bring into that process. We're Keldrack Safety, a small training platform business based in Toronto, Canada. Our product, Aisle Rehearsal, turns everyday warehouse situations into short browser-based lessons: choosing a pedestrian route through a busy aisle, noticing a problem at a loading dock, or passing along a hazard during a shift handover. Supervisors can assign lessons and review completion without assembling their own course materials from scratch.

Our customers are warehouse employers in the United States and Canada. The person arranging a demo is usually responsible for operations, staff onboarding or safety training. They need to see what a supervisor actually does inside the platform and what a worker sees in a lesson. We serve employers in both countries remotely; being based in Toronto does not mean someone needs to visit us. We don't impose an age requirement on demo bookings or require a particular device for booking.

The back-to-school connection is about getting workplace learning back into a regular rhythm. Some customers are welcoming new hires, while others want to refresh familiar routines after summer scheduling changes. Our lessons use warehouse situations rather than classroom imagery. The extra starter pack gives supervisors five short scripts for shift briefings and a checklist for walking a new hire through the site. It's a practical companion to the platform, and it is included free when someone books within the offer window.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "Keldrack Safety is a Toronto-based warehouse safety training platform for employers in the United States and Canada, with browser-based lessons on pedestrian routes, loading docks and shift handovers. Book a free 20-minute walkthrough of our Aisle Rehearsal platform and see how supervisors assign realistic scenarios and review team completion. Book your demo by September 12, 2027, and receive our free back-to-school supervisor starter pack with five shift-briefing scripts and a new-hire walkthrough checklist."

Please send people to https://keldracksafety.com/demo. The walkthrough is free, and booking it does not require buying a subscription. Visitors choose an available appointment and complete the booking on our site. We count a demo when that appointment is confirmed, rather than when somebody opens the calendar, submits an unfinished request or eventually attends. My objective is as many booked demos as possible. That is the result we care about, even though the platform also has other useful things people might browse.

Run the campaign from Sunday, September 5, 2027, through Sunday, September 12, 2027, inclusive. That's eight days in the account's Eastern time zone, using Toronto local time. Please cover the full first and last days. The timing is meant to catch that back-to-school reset while the free starter pack is still available. The September 12 deadline applies to making the booking; the demo appointment itself can take place afterward.

Our site does not have X's pixel installed, so X cannot see our booked demos or attribute those conversions through a pixel. Our scheduling system keeps the confirmed appointment records. Please keep that measurement limitation in mind when you assess how things are going, because link clicks alone are not the outcome I'm asking for.

You may launch and manage the X campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Please watch it throughout the full flight and make the adjustments you judge appropriate as it runs. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks, and clearly distinguish those reported figures from any confirmed demo bookings available in our scheduling records.

Total budget: 850.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
